institution: Sher-i-Kashmir Institute of Medical Sciences, Srinagar
citation: Department of Microbiology, Sher-i-Kashmir Institute of Medical Sciences, Soura, Srinagar. Antibiogram for the year 2021. Srinagar: SKIMS; 2022.
reporting: Percent susceptible by organism, specimen (blood; pus and body fluids; urine) and location (IPD, OPD, ICU), with n per location; organism isolation tables by specimen (totals only, no location split).
method: Testing according to CLSI M100 (printed as "31th ed CLSI supplement M100; 2021"); species with test data for fewer than 30 isolates generally excluded (as stated).

verification.note: Six susceptibility tables (pages 5, 6, 8, 9, 11, 12; drug headers and organism labels are rotated, so the column order was taken from the rendered pages) parsed from the PDF text layer by word position inside the ruled grid (pdfplumber), then every cell compared by eye with the pages rendered at scale 2.2 to 2.5; organism tables (pages 4, 7, 10) checked on the images (2026-09-26). A blind re-read of 6 random cells (value read from a crop of header and row before looking at the extracted value) found no differences.

notes: Specimen-wise antibiogram with each organism split by IPD (wards), OPD and ICU. "Pus & body fluids" is recorded as pus, wounds and body fluids. The organism tables give one total per specimen (no location split), recorded as counts for all settings. Cells printed as "-", "IR" or left blank are left out; values printed as 0 are recorded as 0. Ticarcillin + clavulanate columns have no drug key and are left out. Colistin (blood Gram-negative table) is recorded as printed; a footnote says all pus and urine isolates were susceptible to polymyxin B except Proteus (not a table value, not recorded). Many small-n cells print percentages that their n cannot give (see row notes). Downloaded from the Wayback Machine snapshot web.archive.org/web/20260411170615id_/ of the URL (the SKIMS server refuses scripted downloads). Several blood Gram-negative rows repeat values printed in the 2020 report's pus and body fluids and blood tables (see row notes).
issues: Second reader 2026-09-26: all 654 cells of the six susceptibility tables (pages 5, 6, 8, 9, 11, 12; the seeded sample of 164 plus every other cell), all 65 row n with their IPD/OPD/ICU labels and all 28 organism-table counts (pages 4, 7, 10) re-read against the page images (scale 3, tables cropped into halves or quadrants), each value read before comparing. 0 transcription errors in values, n, settings, organisms or counts; no value corrected.

Cells not kept by the rules (55 cautions, 3 intrinsic), each re-read and printed as recorded: the imipenem and meropenem pairs of blood E. coli IPD (73.3, 41.6) and ICU (46, 80) and Klebsiella IPD (14.5, 52.3), pus E. coli IPD (8.7, 34.3), urine E. coli IPD (11.7, 37.2), OPD (15.5, 41.3) and ICU (100, 0) and urine Klebsiella ICU (0, 100); the arithmetic cautions of the small blood OPD rows (E. coli n=8, Klebsiella n=5, Enterobacter n=1, Pseudomonas n=3, Acinetobacter n=4), blood Enterobacter ICU (n=6), Salmonella IPD ceftriaxone 98.5 (n=6), Acinetobacter IPD piperacillin-tazobactam 13.5 (n=36) and urine E. coli ICU fosfomycin 90.1 (n=3); intrinsic: urine Pseudomonas ampicillin-sulbactam 10 (IPD) and 5 (ICU) and amoxicillin-clavulanate 0 (ICU).

Repeated 2020 figures: my blind read of the 2021 page 6 image matched the file cell for cell, so this report itself prints the blood Gram-negative figures that repeat 2020 figures (2020 values read from the 2020 pages 8 and 10). The overlap is wider than the original five row notes: E. coli ICU (6 of 9 shared drugs equal the 2020 pus row), Pseudomonas OPD (6 of its 7 figures equal the 2020 blood or pus OPD row), Acinetobacter OPD (6 non-zero figures) and Enterobacter ICU (4 non-zero figures) also repeat 2020 figures, and the Enterobacter IPD row also repeats three 2020 blood figures. Notes added to those four rows and the Enterobacter IPD note extended; values stay as printed. Blood Klebsiella IPD shares 4 non-zero figures with 2020 (piperacillin-tazobactam 22, amikacin 40, gentamicin 35 pus; co-trimoxazole 23 blood), not noted. The build's copy check flags only Pseudomonas ICU, since it needs every shared figure identical.

Also confirmed: the CoNS blood OPD row (n=208) and Burkholderia blood IPD row ("n=" with no number) print only "-" and are correctly left out (page 3 gives 95 clinically significant OPD blood isolates); the n=0 rows and Proteus pus ICU (n=2) print only "-"; the organism tables give totals only. Added a note to the pus Proteus IPD and OPD rows, whose n add up to the combined Proteus spp./Morganella/Providencia organism-table row. No black or grey cell markers in this report (IR is printed as text, not-tested as "-" or blank), so no marker was recorded as 0. Institution reads "Sher-i-Kashmir Institute of Medical Sciences, Srinagar"; the Wayback PDF is complete (13 pages, ends with %%EOF).
